blocks.text: GENEVA, Switzerland — Dozens of global health and environmental organizations called on the World Health Organization (WHO) on Tuesday to revise decades-old standards for nitrate levels in drinking water, arguing that they do not reflect recent scientific evidence on potential health risks. In an open letter, 85 organizations, including Greenpeace International and the World Organization of Family Doctors (WONCA), called on the United Nations health agency to include nitrate in an upcoming review of its drinking water guidelines.
